questions.question: At Kingsmead stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Jade de Figueiredo holds it with 21.

questions.question: Who was the first South African woman to take a five-wicket haul in a T20I, achieving the feat before Shabnim Ismail became the second in 2018?
questions.explanation: Ismail's 5 for 30 against India in February 2018 made her the second South African to take a T20I five-wicket haul, after Sune Luus.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Warriors?
How many catches separate the all-time #1 (Nondumiso Shangase) and #2 (Tatum le Roux) fielders (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nondumiso Shangase: 29 — Tatum le Roux: 23 — a gap of 6.

questions.question: Which provincial union holds the record for 'Highest Team Total' in the 19/20 season (List A)?
Kei set a database record (19/20 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 20. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)', held by Kei.
